content.text: My Favourites (0) AddGet BeinlanguageENESEditionUnited StatesbeIN XTRAManage NotificationsContact UsTV GuideHome > Soccer > LaLiga > How far was Arda Güler’s goal in Real Madrid vs Elche?How far was Arda Güler’s goal in Real Madrid vs Elche?03/14/2026 - 11:26 PM - by Miguel CalixtoReal Madrid delivered another impressive performance at the Santiago Bernabéu, where Álvaro Arbeloa’s team sealed the night with a spectacular goal from Arda Güler.Real Madrid delivered another impressive performance at the Santiago Bernabéu, where Álvaro Arbeloa’s team sealed the night with a spectacular goal from Arda Güler.While Federico Valverde once again produced a stunning strike, the spotlight ultimately belonged to the Turkish midfielder, who scored from beyond the halfway line. Did Arda Güler score the longest goal in LaLiga history? According to football statistician MisterChip (Alexis Martín-Tamayo), the goal came from an extraordinary distance.“Arda Güler scored with a shot from 68 meters. It is the longest goal ever scored in LaLiga, tied with the goal by Antonio José for Numancia against Sevilla in 2004 from a very similar distance,” he explained on X.The long-range strike completely caught Elche goalkeeper Matías Dituro off guard and quickly became one of the most remarkable goals of the season. ARDA GÜLER, ARE YOU SERIOUS???A GOAL FROM BEYOND THE HALFWAY LINE 🤯🤯🤯 pic.twitter.com/ZLg1Cj9VJi— ESPN FC (@ESPNFC) March 14, 2026 Real Madrid still chasing Barcelona in LaLiga With the 4-1 victory over Elche, Real Madrid reached 66 points, moving just one point behind Barcelona in the LaLiga standings.Hansi Flick’s Barcelona will face Sevilla on Sunday, and a victory would allow the Catalan side to extend the lead back to four points at the top of the table.
